name: chayyarhub
description: A self-hosted git hub: repositories, code browsing, issues and pull requests
author: Soe Moe Htet (Stephen)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:e2e && npm --prefix web test -- --watch=false
